is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis and Anopheles melas (page 4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-w) and Vgsc L995S (kdr-e) and Ace-1 G280S (ace-1) (page 3, 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 1 (page 4) provides the number of mosquitoes for various kdr genotypes (ReRe, ReRw, ReS, RwRw, RwS, SS) across 44 sites.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Dakar, Senegal (page 2, 4).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical longitudinal entomological surveillance study (page 2).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data for 44 specific sites in Dakar, Senegal (page 4, Figure 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study covers collections from 2007 to 2010 (page 4) and susceptibility tests in 2010, 2011, and 2012 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new longitudinal entomological surveillance study conducted by the authors.

supplement.evidence: The necessary data is provided in the main text and figures.

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance in Anopheles arabiensis populations in Dakar, Senegal, between 2007 and 2012. It reports high frequencies of the kdr-e (L995S) mutation and assesses resistance to multiple insecticides using WHO bioassays and synergist assays (PBO).
